title: 3dBallMatch
description: A tool to find a good match between a ball (filled sphere) of the given radius and a dataset to determine a crude approximate center of the brain quickly.

radius.description: Radius of the 3D ball to match (in mm)
radius.title: Radius

ball_radius.description: Set the radius of the 3D ball to match (mm)
ball_radius.title: Ball Radius

spheroid_axes.description: Match with a spheroid of revolution, with principal axis radius 'a' and secondary axes radii 'b'
spheroid_axes.title: Spheroid Axes
